title: Only one file changed: the map and the facts come from it alone
about: Only d-02 changed. The unchanged SmPC and quality overall summary say 30 months; the changed stability report says 24 months. Strength and site are only in unchanged files, so they are not_found.

pages:
Summary of Product Characteristics (draft, sections 1 to 6)

1. Name of the medicinal product

Rilvomet 500 mg tablets

2. Qualitative and quantitative composition

Each tablet contains 500 mg of rilvomet.

3. Pharmaceutical form

Film-coated tablet. White, oval, biconvex tablets.

6.3 Shelf life

The shelf life of the medicinal product is 30 months.

6.4 Special precautions for storage

Do not store above 30 C.

6.5 Nature and contents of container

Alu/Alu blisters in cartons of 56 tablets.

Stability report: Rilvomet tablets

Contents

3.2.P.8.1 Stability summary and conclusion ........ page 2
3.2.P.8.3 Stability data ........ page 3

3.2.P.8.1 Stability summary and conclusion

Three primary batches of Rilvomet tablets were placed on stability in the proposed commercial pack. All results stayed within specification at every time point. Based on these data, a shelf life of 24 months is proposed when the product is stored below 25 C in the original package.

3.2.P.8.3 Stability data

| Study | Storage condition | Temperature (C) | Relative humidity (%) | Months of data |
| Long-term | 25 C / 60% RH | 25 | 60 | 18 |
| Accelerated | 40 C / 75% RH | 40 | 75 | 6 |

The long-term study was stored at 25 C / 60% RH. 18 months of long-term data are available for all three batches.

3.2.P.3 Manufacture

3.2.P.3.1 Manufacturer(s)

The finished product is manufactured, packaged, tested and released at Southfield Pharma, Plant 3, 90 Weir Road, Brackenholm.

3.2.P.3.3 Description of manufacturing process

Direct compression of the blend, followed by tablet compression, film coating and blister packing. In-process controls are listed in section 3.2.P.3.4.

2.3 Quality Overall Summary

This summary follows the structure of Module 3 for Rilvomet 500 mg tablets.

2.3.S Drug substance

The drug substance is supplied by an approved manufacturer, with details in Module 3.2.S. It is a white to off-white crystalline powder.

2.3.P.2 Pharmaceutical development

The formulation uses a direct compression process with common excipients. The tablets were shown to have a dissolution profile similar to the reference product in three media.

2.3.P.8 Stability

The proposed shelf life is 30 months when stored below 30 C. Details are in Module 3.2.P.8.
